parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Work item type: Req for requirement, Bug for bug, Task for Job, and Risk for threat

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identifier, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Project ID, same as spaceIdentifier, which is the UUID of the project

parameters.name: spaceType
parameters.description: Space type. Set this parameter to Project.
